summary.text: John George is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 36 since November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former police officer, he advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.

paragraphs.text: John George served in the Oklahoma National Guard, reaching the rank of second lieutenant, and earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from East Central University.
His career experience includes working as a police officer, and he has served as president of the Oklahoma City Fraternal Order of Police.
George assumed office on November 23, 2022, succeeding Sean Roberts.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Energy and Natural Resources Oversight Committee and the House Rules Committee.
